en: A black-and-white aerial photograph postcard showing a panoramic view of a town nestled at the base of a mountain range. The town features many clustered buildings, likely residential and historical in nature, with a few prominent church towers visible. There is a scenic landscape of hills and mountains in the background. The border of the postcard is wavy, and there is a caption at the bottom in Portuguese.
